findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED. 

A pair of employees were observed to wash hands and use their bare hands to turn off the faucet. Education was conducted with the PIC and they are instructed to review with staff.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The nozzles of the soda fountain machine are observed soiled. Items were shown to the PIC and cleaned during this inspection to correct. Maintain the food contact items clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed two chest freezers in the garage area that had an accumulation of ice on the inside. One of the chest freezers also had a lid that was misaligned that could lead to a seal that isn't secured, if the lid shifts anymore. Ensure that the freezers are either defrosted, or the ice is cleared from them. Also, ensure the lid is either repaired or maintained in a working condition. 
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed a wet cloth sitting in a bucket that was being used for sanitizer, but there was no sanitizer solution in the bucket. Ensure that wet clothes are either stored in a santizer solution or placed in the dirty laundry.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.citation_text:
750.130 - Box of frozen raw ground beef was observed on a shelf above tubs of cooked beans and chili. Owner moved raw ground beef to proper storage area on the bottom shelf below all other foods.

All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store raw foods below/away from ready to eat foods.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - Mold accumulation was observed in a couple areas inside the ice machine. 

Clean and sanitize inside the ice machine as needed to eliminate buildup of mold.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed that the scoop in the bulk container of taco spice had fallen into the product without the handle extended out of product.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.
Store scoop properly.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed that the damp mop was stored in the mop bucket, not stored upright between uses.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
Hang used mop upright when not in use, so as to promote air drying.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed that the scoop handle in the bulk container of onion powder had fallen into the product. 
750.280- All food handling utensils shall be properly stored with the handle extending out of the product.
Store scoop properly.
CORRECTED= handle was extended out of product.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment: White ice scoop is stored on soda box. Soda box is not considered a clean surface. 750-290 Ice scoop shall be stored on a clean surface or in the ice with the handle extended out of the ice. Scoop moved to top of microwave.  Discussed the installation of a hook next to the ice machine for storage of the scoop.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: The following non-food contact items are in disrepair or no longer smooth and easily cleansable: 1) handle on cooler/freezer combo at serving line 2) the door liner on bottom microwave at cook line. 50-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Repair or replace these items.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.comment: The three part sink was being operated as wash rinse sanitize. However the sinks were set up as wash, sanitize and rinse. 750-820d  Manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing in sink compartments shall be conducted in the following sequence: 1) sinks shall be cleaned prior to use 2) Utensils shall be washed in the first compartment 3) Utensils shall be rinsed in clean water in the second compartment and 4) utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to methods included in Section 750.820(e)(1) through (4).  Set up and use sinks as required by code.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: The test strips for sanitizer appear to have been damaged or dropped into water and are not functional. 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. Provide new test kit.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment: The sanitizer concentration in the 3 part sink was 0ppm of available quat. 750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4). Sink was remade to be at least 200 ppm of quat and the proper number of sanitizer tablets per gallon of water was discussed.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Single use forks are stored in an open bin unprotected. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user. Find and use suitable storage for proper handling of clean utensils that are presented to the public for use.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: The wall to the right of three part sink in the back has areas that re no longer smooth or easily cleansable. 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings. Repair areas to the right of sink were paint is chipped and the wall is not smooth.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Personal food found in walk-in cooler.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.  
Segregate personal food from commercial food.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
(A)  Make line hand washing sink hot water faucet in disrepair.  Repair hand washing sink.  (B)  Hot water faucet in 3-pan sink in back room is leaking.  Repair faucet.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Bathroom coving is pulling away from wall.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
Repair coving.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
(A)  Wall coating next to bathroom sink is eroding.  Repaint/re-seal bathroom wall.  (B)  Raw wood is exposed (paint is wearing down) on bathroom cabinet.  Repaint/seal bathroom cabinet.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The shelves in the back where clean utensils and dishes are being stored are rusty.  Either repair the rusted shelves or purchase new ones.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The gasket of the walk in cooler was damaged and loose.  Replace the gasket. Also, the three compartment sink is not caulked to the wall.  Caulk the sink to the wall.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
The soda diffusers had mold build up.  The diffusers were removed and cleaned during the inspection. CORRECTED.
750-800d The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed a secondary container of salt without a label.  Label with the common name.
750-130f Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed taco salad shells stored in a cardboard box.  Use a container that can be washed, rinsed and sanitized.  The box had a liner of paper towels on the bottom of the box, but the shells touch the side.  The box is not considered a clean surface.
750-130 Ready to eat food shall be stored in a matter to prevent cross-contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed degraded caulk at the hand sink in the food service area.  Re-caulk the sink to the wall.
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Towels were not available at the hand sink in the food prep/dishwashing room.  Corrected: Towels were placed adjacent to the hand sink.  Provide towels at all times.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: A refrigerator in the food prep room has no thermometer.  A thermometer was put in the unit to correct.
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
A serving spoon was stored outside the food.  It was placed in the food to correct.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment: Observed 2 bulk dry food containers that the dispensing scoop in the product where the handle is not extended out of the food product. (Sec 750-280 )  Use proper utensils to dispense product from container.
